facts.fact: Decree n°2021/690 of 2 December 2021 sets the application rules of law n°2020/010 of 20 July 2020 governing statistical activity in Cameroon.

facts.fact: This document is the text of law n°2020/010 of 20 July 2020 governing statistical activity in Cameroon, adopted by Parliament and promulgated by the President.
facts.system: Loi n°2020/010 du 20 juillet 2020 régissant l'activité statistique au Cameroun

facts.fact: The preface of Cameroon's national statistics development strategy 2021-2030 states that Law No. 2020/010 of 20 July 2020 governing statistical activity formally establishes the national statistical information system (Articles 20 to 22) and places the strategy at the centre of statistical activity (Article 3).
